main_measure.name: mean of forecast/10 x (5-bar return minus coin's mean 5-bar return), non-overlapping, pooled
main_measure.threshold: confirm: mean > 0 with t >= 2 over >= 300 cases and timing gain > 0; reject: mean < 0 with t <= -2 over >= 300 cases

supporting_check.name: book mean daily return before costs minus gain from market's rise

reading: Every grid row (0, 5, 10, ...) with a 5-bar return inside its window is a case, flat forecasts included as zero products, and the coin's mean 5-bar return is taken over the same grid of all its windows.
